The letter {{AurB|oo}} was the thirty-second letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet. It was pronounced "orenth" and had the value of /OO/.<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>
